seo.title: Brand compliance checks on every page | Superflow
seo.description: Upload the brand guide. Agents check colors, fonts, logos, product names, tone and legal lines on every page and every change. Your team decides which exceptions stand.

hero.h1: Your brand guide, run on every page.
hero.sub: Upload the guide. Agents check colors, fonts, logos, names, tone and legal lines on every change. Your team decides which exceptions stand.
hero.clientLine: The brand owner taps Approve on each exception from their phone.

pack.name: Brand Agent Pack
pack.intro: Eight agents built from the brand guide. Every page and every uploaded asset.

agents.name: Palette Guard
agents.checks: Checks every color on the page against the brand guide.
agents.finding: Primary button uses #2F80ED. The guide allows #1E5BB8.

agents.name: Font Guard
agents.checks: Checks every font on the page against the brand guide.
agents.finding: Footer uses Arial. The guide allows Inter only.

agents.name: Logo Use
agents.checks: Checks logo version, clear space and minimum size.
agents.finding: Footer logo is 18px wide. The guide sets 32px minimum.

agents.name: Tone Check
agents.checks: Reads copy against the voice guide: banned words, claims, tone.
agents.finding: Press page uses 'best-in-class'. The voice guide bans it.

agents.name: Term Check
agents.checks: Checks product names, capitalization and trademarks.

agents.name: Legal Lines
agents.checks: Checks required disclaimers and trademark lines on every page.
agents.finding: Pricing page is missing the 'prices vary by region' line.

agents.name: Image Style
agents.checks: Finds stock photos, watermarks and off-brand imagery.
agents.finding: /careers uses a stock photo with a visible watermark.

agents.name: Consistency Checker
agents.checks: Finds spacing and components drifting across pages.

buildYourOwn.input: Flag any page that mentions a competitor by name.
buildYourOwn.finding: 3 blog posts name a competitor without the comparison disclaimer.

agentsCheck: Colors, fonts and logos match the guide.
Product names are spelled the guide's way.
Every page carries the legal lines.
No stock or watermarked image slipped in.
youDecide: Which findings go to the client.
When the guide, not the page, is wrong.
What to fix before the campaign.

faq.q: What does the agent read the brand from?
faq.a: Upload the brand guide as a PDF, or paste the rules. Superflow builds the agents from it.

faq.q: Can one workspace hold many brands?
faq.a: Yes. Each client project keeps its own guide and its own agents.

faq.q: Does it check PDFs, images and video too?
faq.a: Yes. Upload the asset and the same agents review it.
